title: localrun.config.json
description: The dependency graph written by 'lrun build', read by plot, pack, verify and up. Safe to edit by hand between steps; build rewrites it from scratch.

SchemaVersion.description: Shape of the file. Absent in files written before 0.5.1, which read as 1. A version newer than the lrun reading it is refused (config-invalid).

RootPath.description: The directory build scanned, absolute. Project paths are relative to it.

LocalNugetPath.description: The local NuGet feed pack and go write into, absolute.

Projects.description: The projects kept, in topological order: dependencies first.

Build.description: How build made the config, which lrun status shows. Absent from configs written before 0.6.0.

BuildRecord.description: Written by build for status; pack, go and up don't read it.

LrunVersion.description: The lrun that wrote the config, as lrun version prints it.

Filters.description: The filters given, as typed (--deps-of WebApp, --with-services), or null without any.

UsersOf.description: The names given to --users-of, or null.

DepsOf.description: The names given to --deps-of, or null.

ChangedProjects.description: With --git-changes, the projects found changed (added to the --users-of names); absent otherwise.

Scanned.description: Projects found, test projects and name collisions excluded.

LeftOut.description: What build left out of the config, one entry per reason.

Repositories.description: The git repositories holding the scanned projects, with their HEAD at build time.

Paths.description: For a name collision: the paths of the projects sharing the name, relative to the root.

Dependents.description: For a name collision or a cycle: the projects kept without their dependency on these.

Path.description: The repository's working directory, relative to RootPath (. for the root itself).

Head.description: The commit checked out, or null in a repository without commits.

Branch.description: The branch checked out, or null when HEAD is detached.

Name.description: The csproj file name without extension: the key filters and dependencies use.

PackageId.description: The id it is packed under (<PackageId>, else <AssemblyName>), only when it isn't the name.

SolutionPath.description: Full path of the first solution referencing it; its commands get its $(SolutionDir). Null when none does.

Type.description: executable when <OutputType> is Exe or WinExe, or, without an <OutputType>, the project SDK is Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web, Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Worker or Microsoft.NET.Sdk.BlazorWebAssembly; else library.

Test.description: A test project, kept with build --tests. Absent when false.

Packable.description: Whether the project produces a package, only when it isn't the default: false for a library with <IsPackable> false (as MSBuild evaluates it, else the csproj), true for a test project whose csproj sets <IsPackable> true. pack plans the libraries producing a package, never an executable; verify expects only those.

LatestVersion.description: The highest version on the project's NuGet sources and the local feed; pack starts from it. Absent with build --csproj, for a project producing no package (an executable, Packable false, a test project), or when none was found.

Dependencies.description: Names of the projects and packages it references, kept in the config or not.

ProjectVersion.description: A version split as Major.Minor.PatchAndSuffix: 1.4.3-dev.2 is 1, 4, "3-dev.2".

PatchAndSuffix.description: The patch number, then the prerelease label and build metadata if any.
